_about: What a security provider is asked, and what each answer must be (contract/security/v1/protocol.md). Each case builds fixture.json's repository fresh, applies `files` (null removes one), and runs `<provider> <verb>` with {"cwd"} plus `request` on stdin; `env` is added to the provider's environment. Every `check` answer must be one result the schema allows, list every control of controls.json as a repository row (unless the request narrows it), and report every provider row not applicable — the fixture is not the provider's repository. `rows` names results the answer must hold; `only` says no other row may appear; `leaked` the kinds a redaction must name.
